alveolar_lumen.name: Alveolar Lumen (Air Space)
alveolar_lumen.description: High oxygen partial pressure (pO2) air space inside the terminal alveolus receiving inhaled atmospheric air.

alveolar_epithelium.name: Alveolar Squamous Epithelium
alveolar_epithelium.description: Extremely thin, single-layer squamous epithelial barrier ensuring a short diffusion path for rapid gas exchange.

capillary_endothelium.name: Pulmonary Capillary Endothelium
capillary_endothelium.description: Single layer of flattened endothelial cells lining the pulmonary capillary, closely apposed to the alveolar wall.

red_blood_cell.name: Red Blood Cell (Erythrocyte)
red_blood_cell.description: Biconcave disc rich in hemoglobin that binds oxygen to form oxyhemoglobin, flowing in single file through narrow capillaries.

o2_diffusion.name: Oxygen Diffusion Direction
o2_diffusion.description: Oxygen diffuses down its partial pressure gradient from high pO2 in alveolar air into deoxygenated blood plasma and red blood cells.

co2_diffusion.name: Carbon Dioxide Diffusion Direction
co2_diffusion.description: Carbon dioxide diffuses down its partial pressure gradient from high pCO2 in pulmonary arterial capillary blood into the alveolar space for exhalation.
